summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration in the MONAI repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs computed from the padding offsets; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter patch generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array. Choices to review: start_pos is passed through unchanged, so its first entry applies to the channel dimension; test_loading_array checks exact coordinates and constant per-patch offsets rather than hardcoded random-shift values, since values could not be computed without running code; the multi-worker check compares coordinates and offsets, not exact values; the GridPatchDataset docstring example output is hand-derived and unverified. Nothing has been executed, and nothing is committed.
